_doc: Bench queue for the hardware matrix, researched 2026-10-15 on ollama.com (sizes = registry download sizes). role curator = judge + monologue + chat; summarizer = perf only (fits/speeds for the setup; its quality bench is tournament_bench). granite4.2:8b/3b run as curators and their perf cells double as the summariser footprint, so they are listed once. profiles: which LLM_PROFILE the quality phase runs. Order = queue order: references first, then by size so pull-ahead overlaps small downloads with big measurements. 'installed' entries were on the box before the bench and are never removed.
